mapper.select: select cov.coupon_name, cov.package_unit_price as saleAmount, crd.refund_amount, group_concat(distinct cfp.account_item_name) as refundType, crd.org_id as orgName, crd.crt_id as executorName, cr.reason as remark from coupon_refund_detail crd inner join coupon_refund_pay cfp on cfp.refund_id = crd.refund_id inner join coupon_order_virtual cov on cov.id = crd.order_virtual_id inner join coupon_refund cr on crd.refund_id = cr.id INNER JOIN card c on c.id = cov.card_id where cov.inservice = 0 and c.sold_target = #{query.patientId} GROUP BY crd.refund_id

select cci.name as couponName, ifnull(c.card_number, c.third_card_number) as cardNumber, sc.name as saleChannel, dip.package_unit_price as saleAmount, cb.item_id as itemName, cb.item_type, count(*) as quantity, cb.patient_id as patientName, b.bill_number, date_format(cb.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `billDate`, cb.org_id as orgName, cb.crt_id as executorName from card_benefit cb inner join card c on cb.card_id = c.id inner join coupon_common_info cci on c.coupon_id = cci.id left join sales_channel sc on sc.id = c.sale_channel_id left join deduction_item_period dip on dip.item_id = cb.item_id and dip.coupon_id = cb.coupon_id and dip.type = cb.item_type left join coupon_order_virtual cov on c.id = cov.card_id left join coupon_bill b on cov.order_id = b.order_record_id where cb.coupon_type = 5 and cb.patient_id = #{query.patientId} and dip.crt_time = (select max(crt_time) from deduction_item_period where coupon_id = cci.id and crt_time <= ifnull(c.sold_date, c.active_date)) group by cb.card_id, b.bill_number, cb.item_id

select cov.coupon_name, cov.package_unit_price as saleAmount, c.buyer_id as patientName, c.sold_target as ownName, date_format(cc.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `date`, cc.crt_id as executorName, cc.remark from card c inner join coupon_order_virtual cov on c.id = cov.card_id inner join card_change cc on c.id = cc.card_id and c.sold_target = cc.curr_id where isnull(c.buyer_id) = 0 and c.sold_target != c.buyer_id and c.sold_target = #{query.patientId}
